topic: 32 fans, one per World Cup club, compete in football challenges (penalties etc.) for $10,000
hero: Presenter in black (Futcrunch host) and fans in club shirts
hook: Man in blue kicking penalty at goal with keeper, then host presents behind crowd of fans
subtitle_style: white/teal bold caps lower-left 'COMING UP' and 'PENALTIES' stencil on grass
reaction_overlays: club crest grid graphics, name lower-thirds, goal outline overlay, reaction inserts
transition_summary: Rapid hard cuts and graphic stings, ~6 cuts per 10 s; crowd shots, quick replays
audio_note: host voice-over ('behind me is one football fan from every club in the World Cup'), upbeat music

reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: own-shot; recreate concept with own cast; remove club crests/branding
